scope: Two B stationary acoustic coordinates; does not qualify generic dynamic clocks or physical RPM
holdout: Contiguous equal halves, remove incomplete four-cycle windows; no window may cross the split
power_scope: Central harmonic observations compared to independently known true-phase resampling, not total broadband power
policy: Use saved primary source coordinates unchanged. Original local and generic gates remain failed. No alternate reference/window/interval search. Any failed positive control blocks export using this estimator. Negative controls must not yield a supported profile. No accepted-model/default change.
